disorder-name.detail: 147 pediatric patients diagnosed with brainstem tumors (including DIPG 78.8% and non-DIPG 21.2%); all treated as a single clinical cohort. Inclusion criteria: initial diagnosis of brainstem tumor with no prior treatment, tumors confined to the brainstem, no comorbid psycho-neurological or behavioral disorders, no developmental disorder history.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A cohort of 171 pediatric patients (age range: 4–17 years) diagnosed with brainstem tumors at the Department of Neurosurgery, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, were enrolled between April 2019 and December 2022." "After these removals, 147 patients were included in the final analysis."

dataset-of-origin.detail: All 147 patients were recruited from the Department of Neurosurgery, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University — a single institution. No publicly named dataset is used for the clinical cohort.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "A cohort of 171 pediatric patients (age range: 4–17 years) diagnosed with brainstem tumors at the Department of Neurosurgery, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China, were enrolled between April 2019 and December 2022."
